say:1:1130203001:1.text: This is fairly standard for any scholar worth his salt.
say:1:1130203001:1.source_cn: 当然，这可是一名学者的基本技能。

say:2:1130203002:1.text: A scholar's career and reputation each hinge on the quality of the research papers he publishes.
say:2:1130203002:1.source_cn: 学者的重要程度取决于他发表论文的重要程度。

say:3:1130203003:1.text: If I stay true to my course, I'll become an expert in Mauler behavioral studies.
say:3:1130203003:1.source_cn: 如果我将这些内容加以研究，那我就会成为蛮血的重要专家！

say:4:1130203004:1.text: The renowned scholar Ravan... ha! I'm getting excited just thinking about it.
say:4:1130203004:1.source_cn: 尊敬的瑞韦恩专家……哈哈，想想都令人激动。
